sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Test your knowledge of hour forms and time of day
sets.descriptionRussian: Проверьте знание форм слова «час» и времени суток

items.promptEnglish: I come home at six o'clock.
The show starts at one o'clock.
items.explanation: For 1 o'clock, simply say в час (not один час in everyday speech).

items.promptEnglish: The concert is at eight o'clock.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The class starts at three o'clock.
minimalPairs.explanation: After 3 (in the 2-4 range), use часа: три часа.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The train departs at ten o'clock.
minimalPairs.explanation: After 10 (in the 5-12 range), use часов: десять часов.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Breakfast is at seven in the morning.
minimalPairs.explanation: 7 in the morning = семь утра. Утра means AM/morning.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The movie is at nine in the evening.
minimalPairs.explanation: A movie at 9 is typically in the evening: девять вечера.

sets.title: Fill and Sort
sets.description: Fill in the correct hour forms and sort times by part of day
sets.descriptionRussian: Вставьте правильные формы и рассортируйте время по частям суток

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Hour form depends on the number: 1 = час, 2-4 = часа, 5-12 = часов.
explanations: В час: for 1 o'clock, say час (not один час).

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these times by part of day

translation.english: The train arrives at three o'clock.
translation.hint: train = поезд, arrives = приходит, 3 = три часа

translation.english: I go to bed at ten in the evening.
translation.answer: Я ложусь спать в десять вечера.
acceptableVariants: Я ложусь спать в десять часов вечера.
translation.hint: go to bed = ложусь спать, ten = десять, evening = вечера
translation.grammarFocus: Time of day: вечера for evening

translation.english: What time is it? Five o'clock.
translation.hint: What time = Который час, five = пять часов

sets.title: Spot the Errors
sets.description: Find and fix errors in time expressions
sets.descriptionRussian: Найдите и исправьте ошибки во временных выражениях

errorCorrection.explanation: After 2, 3, 4, use часа (not часов): два часа.
After 5-12, use часов (not час): семь часов.
After 5-12, use часов: десять часов (not часа).
After 2, 3, 4, use часа (not часов): четыре часа.

items.promptEnglish: People usually sleep at two in the morning.
items.hint: 2 AM is in the middle of the night.
items.explanation: 2 AM = два часа ночи. Ночи means 'at night' (roughly midnight to 4 AM).

items.promptEnglish: Lunch is usually at one in the afternoon.
items.explanation: В час дня = at 1 PM. For one o'clock, use час.

items.promptEnglish: We have dinner at seven in the evening.
items.explanation: 7 PM = семь вечера. Вечера means 'in the evening.'

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A mixed challenge covering all time expressions
sets.descriptionRussian: Смешанное задание по всем временным выражениям

patternRecognition.sentence: один час, два часа, пять часов
patternRecognition.question: What determines which form of 'hour' to use?
patternRecognition.explanation: The number determines the form: 1 = час, 2-4 = часа, 5-12 = часов.

patternRecognition.question: What do these four words indicate?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are time-of-day markers: утра (morning), дня (afternoon), вечера (evening), ночи (night).

patternRecognition.sentence: в час, в два часа, в три часа, в четыре часа
patternRecognition.question: Why does час appear alone with 1 but часа appears with 2, 3, and 4?
options: 1 uses the base form час; 2-4 use the special form часа
It is a spelling difference only
Час and часа mean different things
patternRecognition.answer: 1 uses the base form час; 2-4 use the special form часа
patternRecognition.explanation: Russian numbers govern noun forms: 1 = nominative singular (час), 2-4 = genitive singular (часа), 5+ = genitive plural (часов).

minimalPairs.explanation: Noon = двенадцать дня. Midnight would be двенадцать ночи.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I have breakfast at eight in the morning.
minimalPairs.explanation: Breakfast is in the morning: восемь утра (8 AM).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Work starts at four in the afternoon.
minimalPairs.explanation: After 4 (in the 2-4 range), use часа: в четыре часа дня.

blanks: Собрание в одиннадцать _____. (The meeting is at eleven o'clock.)
Кафе открывается в _____ утра. (The cafe opens at eight in the morning.)
Сколько сейчас _____? (What time is it now?)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Hour forms, numbers with time, asking time.
explanations: В восемь утра: the number goes before the time-of-day word.
Сколько времени? is another way to ask 'What time is it?' Времени is genitive of время.
